programme.desc: 'S13/E3'. Johan Jacobus Williams is skuldig bevind aan drie moorde, verkragtings, ontvoerings, en ander misdade, na hy in 2018 verskeie vrouens gelok het met die belofte van weksgeleendhede en hulle dan vermoor het.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S13/E4'. Cheryl-Ann Kannemeyer, 'n bekende plaaslike eiendomsagent, is met ernstige beserings dood gevind in haar motor. Vriende en familie was geskok toe die misdadiger haar eie man is.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S13/E5'. Robin Smith, bekend as Chris Boshoff, en sy vrou word deur die Valke arressteer na hulle Robin se dood vervals het. 'n Lewensversekeringseis van meer as R1,7 miljoen is by Old Mutual ingedien.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S13/E6'. Die oproep wat geen ouer moet kry nie: Die nuus dat jou dogter haar eie lewe geneem het. Met gebroke harte het Nadia Lloyd se ouers dadelik te werk gegaan om die waarheid te leer... met ontstellende gevolge.

programme.title: Verander jou siening
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Willem Botha en Lizette Smith, 'n blinde dresseer-ruiter, deel 'n liefde vir perde. In hierdie episode ruil Willem sy grimeerborsels vir leisels en 'n blinddoek.

programme.title: Middeljare-mojo Met Marna
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. Marelize Steyn Earle bewys dis nooit te laat om te blom nie. Shahnaz ontmasker velsorgmites wat jou dalk mislei. En Suzette? Sy maak beleggings so maklik soos 1-2-3!

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S31/E8'. Paul van Niekerk van Boshoek Bovelders en die Anhali-familieboerdery tussen Memel en Verkykerskop in die Vrystaat is Voermol se 2025 Beesboer van die Jaar.

programme.title: Goeiemôre, good morning
programme.desc: 'S1/E111'. Dié ontbytprogram sal seker maak Suid-Afrikaners begin hulle dag met al die inligting wat hulle kort. Ons dek alles van nuus en finansies tot leefstyl en vermaak en alles tussenin.

programme.title: Die Tuinmakers
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. Vir Paul Odendaal is tuinmaak 'n romantiese avontuur. Hy kombineer die romantiek van kleure en teksture met sy kliënt se behoeftes. Ná 'n dag van skep, trek hy hom terug in sy eie tuinkokon vol plante, kerse en ligte.

programme.title: Wie Was Dit?
programme.desc: 'S3/E5'. Die speurders is onder geweldige druk. Vennootskappe word gemaak en gebreek. Wie hou uiteindelik die goue vergrootglas vas en neem die boerpot huistoe?

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S18/E3'. In September 2016 verdwyn Martha Jordaan, van Kroonstad, spoorloos. Wayne Errol Henstock, wat in 'n verhouding met Martha was en saam met haar gewoon het, het vir mense vertel dat sy werk op 'n gasteplaas gekry het.

programme.title: Goeiemôre, good morning
programme.desc: 'S1/E111'. Dié ontbytprogram sal seker maak Suid-Afrikaners begin hulle dag met al die inligting wat hulle kort. Ons dek alles van nuus en finansies tot leefstyl en vermaak en alles tussenin.

programme.title: Ons Gesels Balans
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Dit kan moeilik wees om balans te vind wanneer jou huishouding uitbrei. Hierdie week kom kuier my vriendin Kara du Toit, aktrise en nuwe mamma, by my. Ons gesels oor hoe om balans te vind as jong ma en deel praktiese wenke.

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S31/E7'. Die eerstegeslag-entrepreneursboerderyfamilie Joos Solms (en kie) bedryf 'n boerdery, meule, bakkery-deli en gastehuis naby Winterton in KZN. Sy ingenieurs-onderneming, Plantkor, is ook diep betrokke in die landbousektor.

programme.title: 'n Nuwe jy met Nova
programme.desc: 'S2/E5'. Op die oog af het jong mamma Chante Serfontein alles onder beheer, maar onder die oppervlak skuil onsekerhede en innerlike seer. Elana help haar om haar vel én haar hart 'n nuwe lus vir die lewe te gee.

programme.title: Erfenis in die grond
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. Grootkaliesfontein: Die Janse van Rensburgs boer al vir vier generasies met skape naby Philippolis in die Vrystaat op hul geskiedenisryke plaas Grootkaliesfontein.

programme.title: Goeiemôre, good morning
programme.desc: 'S1/E111'. Dié ontbytprogram sal seker maak Suid-Afrikaners begin hulle dag met al die inligting wat hulle kort. Ons dek alles van nuus en finansies tot leefstyl en vermaak en alles tussenin.

programme.title: Manne Agter Die Potte
programme.desc: 'S1/E8'. Mertia, vernoem na die ouma van die restaurateur Marais Kirsten-Uys, in die hart van Stellenbosch, bied saam met sjef Matt van den Berg 'n intieme, plaaslike eetervaring.

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai
programme.desc: 'S14/E2'. Ons gunstelingtydverdryf is nou 'n sosiale eksperiment. Drie paartjies wat mekaar nie ken nie, braai by mekaar en heelwat gebeur om die vuur. En ons praat nie net van die lekker kos nie!

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S3/E5'. Drie deelnemers se algemene kennis word oor drie strawwe rondtes behoorlik op die proef gestel. Verder word hul kennis van mense ook getoets en of hulle onder druk hul beste kan lewer. Kom ons kyk Wie weet wat?

programme.title: Ons Gesels Balans
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Hierdie week kom kuier my ma, Aletta Kruger, en deel haar wysheid oor ouer word. Ons gesels oor die impak wat menopouse op jou vel het, maak 'n gesonde maaltyd en wys hoe om jou dag vol energie te hou.

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S31/E8'. Paul van Niekerk van Boshoek Bovelders en die Anhali-familieboerdery tussen Memel en Verkykerskop in die Vrystaat is Voermol se 2025 Beesboer van die Jaar.

programme.title: 'n Nuwe jy met Nova
programme.desc: 'S2/E6'. Morné Flemming glo dat mans ook met trots mooi na hulself kan kyk. Sy reis begin met 'n vars velsorgroetine en 'n nuwe haarlyn om sy selfbeeld 'n hupstoot te gee.

programme.title: Erfenis in die grond
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Groote Post: Naby Darling in die Wes-Kaap boer die Pentz-familie al vir vier generasies. Hulle het as melkboere begin, maar deesdae maak hulle heerlike wyn.

programme.title: Middeljare-mojo Met Marna
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Levena Josephs se kragtige verhaal oor tweede kanse en hoe sy vir 'n doel gered is. Shahnaz onthul die geheime konneksie tussen beweging, jou ingesteldheid en 'n gloeiende vel.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S18/E4'. In Januarie 2016 word Marius Botha se lyk in sy huis in gevind. In November 2020, vier jaar later, word iemand eers, vir sy moord, in hegtenis geneem en word in Maart 2025 aan moord met voorbedagte rade skuldig bevind.

programme.title: Bietjie Brittanje

programme.desc: 'S1/E56'. Ferit's past catches up with him, and his feelings for Leyla only complicate matters. As tensions rise, will he choose love over duty, or is his loyalty to the job stronger?

programme.title: Twist of Fate
programme.desc: 'S2/E5'. After seeing a picture of Abhi and Pragya together, Aliya starts to get suspicious of Abhi.

programme.title: Broken Bonds
programme.desc: 'S1/E90'. Kuldeep apologises to Rishi and asks him to stay with him. Rishi is determined to go live with Shubhra. They bid Mumbai adieu. Later, they arrive at their home in Pune.

programme.title: This Is Love
programme.desc: 'S1/E82 - 1/82'. Raman relives painful memories on his son's birthday. Ashok throws a birthday party for Aditya - will he invite Raman?

programme.title: Naagin

programme.title: Willowton
programme.desc: 'S1/E50 - Coconut Custard Tart'. A cooking show inspiring home cooks with fresh ideas, practical tips, and easy, creative recipes.

programme.title: Uzozisola - Regrets
programme.desc: 'S1/E125'. The Malhotra family is thrilled for Mauli and Ishan's wedding. The pandit sets the wedding a month away but suggests an engagement in 2 days. Excited, Misti calls Pari to share the news.

programme.title: eKasi: Our Stories
programme.desc: 'S5/E40 - Ama Love Back'. Eza is a former cop who was released from psychiatric hospital. Clinging to the source of hope leading to his ultimate release, he stalks his ex-girlfriend and her current boyfriend.

programme.title: Ashes To Ashes
programme.desc: 'S2/E48 - 2/48'. Selo is tempted to sell Mandlakazi's jewels, but gets his car evaluated instead. Selo plays Makhoza. Mpho and Tsietsi bond as they go for the paternity test. Tsietsi gets word that Kgosi has been stabbed.

programme.title: Gold Diggers
programme.desc: 'S2/E87 - The Saving'. In a stand-off with Zakes and General, Steel ends up on the losing side. Gavin and May have a little fun together. Big boy tries to convince Lucky to turn away from crime.

programme.title: Naagin
programme.desc: 'S4/E4'. After her unsuccessful attempt to kill Dev, Nayantara gets another opportunity at vengeance from the Parikhs as she decides to kill Dev's grandmother and expose his real identity as an shape shifting serpent!

programme.title: The Other Wife
programme.desc: 'S1/E57'. Sema's patience wears thin as Karan and Ceylan's bond intensifies. But with secrets and betrayals lurking, will Sema succeed in her plan to win Karan back?

programme.title: Sout van die Aarde

programme.title: Chrysalis

programme.title: Yosef

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Ramen Japan
programme.desc: Enjoy Tonkotsu ramen, which is loved by Okayama locals with a classic topping - pork cutlet - and a fragrant chicken broth bowl!

programme.title: Core Kyoto Mini
programme.desc: Hina dolls which represent the emperor, empress and imperial court are presented to girls on the first 3rd of March after they are born as part of Girls' Day celebrations.

programme.title: Easy Japanese For Work
programme.desc: This time: obtaining permission. Tran Van Vuong from Vietnam works as a fishing rod designer and tends to use 'daijoobu' instead of 'yoroshii' - by role-playing, he learns how to ask for permission.

programme.title: Zero Waste Life
programme.desc: Judo instructor Sato Hitoe uses worn-out uniforms (gis) to make items like tote bags - very durable since the original material was meant to be tough, behind it all is Sato's love for judo.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Somewhere Street
programme.desc: Davao, located on Mindanao Island, is home to 1.7 million people - global business such as call centres are now thriving here, and the city is often cited as one of the safest in the Philippines.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Tradition Inspires A Green Future
programme.desc: Aditya Sharma seeks a sustainable balance between protecting the planet and meeting consumer demand for clothing - he explores a Japanese tradition in the hopes of finding inspiration.

programme.title: IMPACTS: Climates Change The World
programme.desc: Rising temperatures due to climate change have affected the behaviour of bees - with fewer bees and shorter pollination periods, a threat is posed to agriculture that could lead to a food crisis.

programme.title: Carving The Spirit Of Fishermen
programme.desc: Hokkaido / Takeya Takayuki (Model Maker): Fishing boats in the herring industry that thrived here until the 1950s featured swirling decorations that made a big impression on Hokkaido native Takeya.

programme.title: Where We Call Home
programme.desc: We meet two Americans who preserve Japanese traditions - Chris Hinds ensures safe conduct in Nozawa Onsen's fire festival in Nagano, and Andrew Mancabelli crafts Japanese armour in Warabi in Saitama.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Kaizoku
programme.desc: The Murakami Kaizoku were seafarers and fighters in the Seto Inland Sea - we explore their history and legacy with footage from time-lapse creator Shimizu Daisuke. This time: the Kurushima Straits.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Japan is one of the most volcanically active nations - its world-leading research on volcanic disasters has led to new technologies to track underground magma and predict phreatic eruptions.

programme.title: Activate Your Japanese
programme.desc: Learn how to make the most of your Japanese skills - watch our drama that features useful communication strategies, our snappy videos about onomatopoeia, and our documentaries on 'senpai' in Japan.

programme.title: Culture Crossroads
programme.desc: Efforts to save children have evolved in a unique way that energises people who provide services - we introduce a splendid international example of such an initiative in Matsuyama in Ehime Prefecture.

programme.title: Hello! NHK World-Japan
programme.desc: In a special feature on Hokkaido, programmes looked at the ecology of brown bears, a special bento lunch, and a bountiful landscape formed by rugged natural conditions and pioneering development.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
